convert_eqv2_to_hydra: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script to convert an Equiformer v2 checkpoint and config to Hydra format
convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra: call convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra to transform an eqv2 checkpoint and yaml config into Hydra-compatible files
run_eqv2_conversion_cli: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 CLI tool with --eqv2-checkpoint, --eqv2-yaml, --hydra-eqv2-checkpoint, and --hydra-eqv2-yaml arguments
review_eqv2_to_hydra_conversion: review the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script that converts Equiformer v2 model artifacts to Hydra configuration format
summarize_eqv2_conversion: summarize the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 module which wraps convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra for CLI usage
